case.summary: The $100.07 online purchase on 2016-12-07 deviates from the cardholder’s long-standing pattern of in-person purchases. The same device and customer have been linked to several confirmed account-takeover cases. Multiple other cards are tied to this device, indicating coordinated abuse. Given the strong historical fraud evidence, the transaction is deemed fraudulent.
